    public class Measure

        public static const EM:String = "em";
        public static const EX:String = "ex";
        public static const PIXELS:String = "pixels";
        public static const CH:String = "ch";
        public static const PERCENT:String = "percent";
        public static const RATIO:String = "ratio";
        public static const INCHES:String = "inches";
        public static const CENTIMETERS:String = "centimeters";
        public static const MILLIMETERS:String = "millimeters";
        public static const POINTS:String = "points";
        public static const PICAS:String = "picas";
        public static const DEGREES:String = "degrees";

        public var unit:String;
        public var chSize:Number = -1;
        public var emSize:Number = -1;
        public var value:Number;
        public var exSize:Number = -1;

        public function Measure(_arg_1:Number=0, _arg_2:String="pixels"):void
        {
            this.value = _arg_1;
            this.unit = _arg_2;
        }

        public function relativeTo(_arg_1:Number, _arg_2:Object=null):Number
        {
            switch (unit)
            {
                case Measure.PIXELS:
                    return (value);
                case Measure.PERCENT:
                    return (_arg_1 * (value / 100));
                case Measure.RATIO:
                    return (_arg_1 * value);
                case Measure.POINTS:
                    return ((value / 72) * Capabilities.screenDPI);
                case Measure.INCHES:
                    return (value * Capabilities.screenDPI);
                case Measure.CENTIMETERS:
                    return ((value / 2.54) * Capabilities.screenDPI);
                case Measure.MILLIMETERS:
                    return ((value / 25.4) * Capabilities.screenDPI);
                case Measure.PICAS:
                    return ((value / 6) * Capabilities.screenDPI);
                case Measure.EM:
                    updateFontSizes();
                    return (value * emSize);
                case Measure.EX:
                    updateFontSizes();
                    return (value * exSize);
                case Measure.CH:
                    updateFontSizes();
                    return (value * chSize);
                default:
                    return (value);
            };
        }

        public function valueOf():Number
        {
            return (relativeTo(100));
        }

        private function updateFontSizes():void
        {
            if (emSize < 0)
            {
                emSize = ((12 / 72) * Capabilities.screenDPI);
            };
            if (exSize < 0)
            {
                exSize = ((6 / 72) * Capabilities.screenDPI);
            };
            if (chSize < 0)
            {
                chSize = ((12 / 72) * Capabilities.screenDPI);
            };
        }

        public function toString():String
        {
            return (value.toString() + unit);
        }


    }

{

    import flash.display.Graphics;
    import flash.geom.Rectangle;

    public interface IGraphic 
    {

        function get percentWidth():Number;
        function set percentWidth(_arg_1:Number):void;
        function get fill():IGraphicsFill;
        function draw(_arg_1:Graphics, _arg_2:Rectangle):void;
        function get width():Number;
        function get stroke():IGraphicsStroke;
        function removeEventListener(_arg_1:String, _arg_2:Function, _arg_3:Boolean=false):void;
        function get name():String;
        function set width(_arg_1:Number):void;
        function addEventListener(_arg_1:String, _arg_2:Function, _arg_3:Boolean=false, _arg_4:int=0, _arg_5:Boolean=false):void;
        function set height(_arg_1:Number):void;
        function get fills():Array;
        function get target():DisplayObjectContainer;
        function get percentHeight():Number;
        function get measuredHeight():Number;
        function set fill(_arg_1:IGraphicsFill):void;
        function set name(_arg_1:String):void;
        function set percentHeight(_arg_1:Number):void;
        function set fills(_arg_1:Array):void;
        function set target(_arg_1:DisplayObjectContainer):void;
        function get height():Number;
        function get parent():DisplayObjectContainer;
        function get measuredWidth():Number;
        function set x(_arg_1:Number):void;
        function set y(_arg_1:Number):void;
        function set strokes(_arg_1:Array):void;
        function set stroke(_arg_1:IGraphicsStroke):void;
        function get x():Number;
        function get y():Number;
        function get strokes():Array;
        function endDraw(_arg_1:Graphics):void;

    }
}//package com.degrafa

//com.evony.common.MouseManager

package com.evony.common
{
    import mx.managers.CursorManager;
    import flash.ui.Mouse;

    public class MouseManager 
    {

        private static var isBusy:Boolean = false;


        public static function setNormal():void
        {
            if (isBusy)
            {
                try
                {
                    isBusy = false;
                    CursorManager.removeBusyCursor();
                }
                catch(e:Error)
                {
                    Mouse.show();
                };
            };
        }

        public static function setBusy():void
        {
            if (!isBusy)
            {
                try
                {
                    isBusy = true;
                    CursorManager.setBusyCursor();
                }
                catch(e:Error)
                {
                    Mouse.show();
                };
            };
        }


    }
}//package com.evony.common

        public static function sortBuffArray(_arg_1:ArrayCollection):void
        {
            var _local_3:int;
            var _local_4:BuffBean;
            if (_arg_1.length <= 1)
            {
                return;
            };
            var _local_2:int;
            while (_local_2 < _arg_1.length)
            {
                _local_3 = 0;
                while (_local_3 < ((_arg_1.length - 1) - _local_2))
                {
                    if (instance.getSortId(_arg_1.getItemAt(_local_3).typeId) > instance.getSortId(_arg_1.getItemAt((_local_3 + 1)).typeId))
                    {
                        _local_4 = new BuffBean();
                        _local_4 = (_arg_1.getItemAt(_local_3) as BuffBean);
                        _arg_1.setItemAt(_arg_1.getItemAt((_local_3 + 1)), _local_3);
                        _arg_1.setItemAt(_local_4, (_local_3 + 1));
                    };
                    _local_3++;
                };
                _local_2++;
            };
        }

        public static function buffFilter(_arg_1:ArrayCollection):ArrayCollection
        {
            var _local_5:String;
            var _local_2:int = _arg_1.length;
            var _local_3:ArrayCollection = new ArrayCollection();
            var _local_4:int;
            while (_local_4 < _local_2)
            {
                _local_3.addItem(_arg_1[_local_4]);
                for each (_local_5 in buffFilterArr)
                {
                    if (_local_5 == _arg_1[_local_4].typeId)
                    {
                        _local_3.removeItemAt((_local_3.length - 1));
                    };
                };
                _local_4++;
            };
            return (_local_3);
        }


        private function getSortId(_arg_1:String):int
        {
            var _local_2:int;
            var _local_3:int;
            while (_local_3 < buffArr.length)
            {
                if (_arg_1 == buffArr[_local_3])
                {
                    _local_2 = _local_3;
                    break;
                };
                _local_3++;
            };
            return (_local_2);
        }

    public class UIFactory 
    {

        private var constructFrontUp:EvonyAnimation = null;
        private var townHallConstructFrontUp:EvonyAnimation = null;
        private var constructBackUp:EvonyAnimation = null;

        private var buildingHammerMovie:EvonyAnimation = null;

        private var buildingTooltip:BuildingTooltip = new BuildingTooltip();

        private var timeUITip:TimeUITip = new TimeUITip();
        private var equipConditionTooltip:EquipConditionTooltip = new EquipConditionTooltip();


        public static function getInstance():UIFactory
        {
            return (instance);
        }


        public function getBuildingHammerMovie():EvonyAnimation
        {
            if (buildingHammerMovie == null)
            {
                buildingHammerMovie = new EvonyAnimation();
                buildingHammerMovie.load(EvonyAnimation.TYPE_HammerIn, -1, ResourceLoader.LOAD_BACKGROUND_DEMAND, 0, false, true);

package com.evony.net.client

    import flash.events.EventDispatcher;
    import flash.utils.ByteArray;
    import flash.net.Socket;
    import flash.events.Event;
    import flash.events.ProgressEvent;
    import flash.events.IOErrorEvent;
    import flash.events.SecurityErrorEvent;

    public class GameClient extends EventDispatcher 
    {

        private static const VERSION_COMMAND:String = "gameClient.version";
        private static const MAX_PACKAGE_LEN:int = 0x100000;

        private var serverIp:String;
        private var version:String = null;
        private var mainBuffer:ByteArray;
        private var amfObj:Object;
        private var processedCount:int;
        private var serverPort:int;
        private var lock:Boolean = false;
        private var readed:int = 0;
        private var dataLength:int = 0;
        private var socket:Socket;

        public function GameClient()
        {
            socket = new Socket();
            socket.addEventListener(Event.CONNECT, connectionHandler);
            socket.addEventListener(Event.CLOSE, disconnectionHandler);
            socket.addEventListener(ProgressEvent.SOCKET_DATA, incomingDataHandler);
            socket.addEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, ioErrorHandler);
            socket.addEventListener(SecurityErrorEvent.SECURITY_ERROR, ioErrorHandler2);
        }

        public function getServerIp():String
        {
            return (serverIp);
        }

        public function isConnectioned():Boolean
        {
            return (socket.connected);
        }

        private function incomingDataHandler(e:ProgressEvent):void
        {
            var needRead:int;
            var tempBuffer:ByteArray;
            if (lock)
            {
                throw (new Error(((((((("Socket.bytesAvailable=" + socket.bytesAvailable) + "\tprocessedCount=") + processedCount) + "\treaded=") + readed) + " dataLength:") + (dataLength & 0x7FFFFFFF))));
            };
            lock = true;
            while (socket.bytesAvailable > 0)
            {
                if (dataLength == 0)
                {
                    dataLength = socket.readInt();
                    readed = 0;
                    if ((((dataLength & 0x7FFFFFFF) > MAX_PACKAGE_LEN) || ((dataLength & 0x7FFFFFFF) < 0)))
                    {
                        throw (new Error(("The package size is illegal. len=" + dataLength)));
                    };
                    mainBuffer = new ByteArray();
                    processedCount = 0;
                };
                needRead = ((dataLength & 0x7FFFFFFF) - readed);
                if (needRead > this.socket.bytesAvailable)
                {
                    needRead = this.socket.bytesAvailable;
                };
                if (needRead < 0)
                {
                    throw (new Error(((((((("The package available size is illegal .lenNeedRead=" + needRead) + "\tremain=") + socket.bytesAvailable) + "\tprocessedCount=") + processedCount) + "\treaded=") + readed)));
                };
                try
                {
                    this.readed = (this.readed + needRead);
                    tempBuffer = new ByteArray();
                    socket.readBytes(tempBuffer, 0, needRead);
                    mainBuffer.writeBytes(tempBuffer);
                    processedCount++;
                }
                catch(err:Error)
                {
                    dispatchEvent(new GameClientEvent(GameClientEvent.ON_ERROR));
                };
                if (readed == (dataLength & 0x7FFFFFFF))
                {
                    this.lock = false;
                    mainBuffer.position = 0;
                    if ((dataLength & 0x80000000))
                    {
                        mainBuffer.uncompress();
                        trace(((("mainBuffer " + mainBuffer.length) + "read len : ") + readed));
                        mainBuffer.position = 0;
                    };
                    amfObj = mainBuffer.readObject();
                    mainBuffer = null;
                    dataLength = 0;
                    processedCount = 0;
                    readed = 0;
                    if (!amfObj)
                    {
                        dispatchEvent(new GameClientEvent(GameClientEvent.ON_ERROR));
                        return;
                    };
                    if (checkCommand(amfObj))
                    {
                        return;
                    };
                    dispatchEvent(new GameClientEvent(GameClientEvent.ON_EXTENSION_RESPONSE, amfObj));
                };
            };
            this.lock = false;
        }

        private function connectionHandler(_arg_1:Event):void
        {
            trace("socket connection event");
            sendMessage(VERSION_COMMAND, version);
            dispatchEvent(new GameClientEvent(GameClientEvent.ON_CONNECTION));
        }

        private function ioErrorHandler2(_arg_1:SecurityErrorEvent):void
        {
            trace(("the network connection has IOError : " + _arg_1.text));
            dispatchEvent(new GameClientEvent(GameClientEvent.ON_ERROR));
        }

        public function setVersion(_arg_1:String):void
        {
            this.version = _arg_1;
        }

        public function getServerPort():int
        {
            return (serverPort);
        }

        public function connection(_arg_1:String, _arg_2:int):void
        {
            if (!version)
            {
                throw (new RequiredVersionError("the GameClient required a version."));
            };
            trace(("connect the server : " + _arg_1));
            trace(("1 connect the server : " + _arg_1));
            socket.connect(_arg_1, _arg_2);
            dataLength = 0;
        }

        public function sendMessage(_arg_1:String, _arg_2:Object):void
        {
            if (!isConnectioned())
            {
                throw (new NotConnectionedError("the connection is not ready, yet."));
            };
            var _local_3:Object = new Object();
            _local_3.cmd = _arg_1;
            _local_3.data = _arg_2;
            var _local_4:ByteArray = new ByteArray();
            _local_4.writeObject(_local_3);
            socket.writeInt(_local_4.length);
            socket.writeBytes(_local_4);
            socket.flush();
        }

        private function checkCommand(_arg_1:Object):Boolean
        {
            trace(("package id : " + _arg_1.data.packageId));
            switch (_arg_1.cmd)
            {
                case KickoutEvent.KICKOUT:
                    dispatchEvent(new KickoutEvent(KickoutEvent.KICKOUT, _arg_1.data));
                    disconnection();
                    return (true);
                case ErrorVersionEvent.ERROR_VERSION:
                    dispatchEvent(new ErrorVersionEvent(ErrorVersionEvent.ERROR_VERSION, _arg_1.data));
                    disconnection();
                    return (true);
            };
            return (false);
        }

        private function ioErrorHandler(_arg_1:IOErrorEvent):void
        {
            trace(("the network connection has IOError : " + _arg_1.text));
            dispatchEvent(new GameClientEvent(GameClientEvent.ON_ERROR));
        }

        public function disconnection():void
        {
            try
            {
                socket.close();
            }
            catch(e:Error)
            {
                trace(e.message);
            };
            disconnectionHandler(new Event(Event.CLOSE));
        }

        private function disconnectionHandler(_arg_1:Event):void
        {
            trace("socket connection was disconnect");
            dispatchEvent(new GameClientEvent(GameClientEvent.ON_CONNECTION_LOST));
        }

        protected function selectItem(item:IListItemRenderer, shiftKey:Boolean, ctrlKey:Boolean, transition:Boolean=true):Boolean
        {

        private function loadContent(classOrString:Object):void
        {

            var cls:Class;

                    }

                            loader.contentLoaderInfo.addEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, contentLoaderInfo_ioErrorEventHandler);
                            loader.contentLoaderInfo.addEventListener(Event.OPEN, contentLoaderInfo_openEventHandler);
                            loader.contentLoaderInfo.addEventListener(ProgressEvent.PROGRESS, contentLoaderInfo_progressEventHandler);

    public class CastleFlagMc extends EvonyAnimation 
    {

        public function CastleFlagMc()
        {
            this.load(TYPE_Banner, -1);
            this.gotoAndStopNative(1);
        }

        public function setMapCastleBean(_arg_1:MapCastleBean, _arg_2:Boolean=false):void
        {
            if (!_arg_1.npc)
            {
                if (_arg_1.userName == Context.getInstance().getPlayerBean().playerInfo.userName)
                {
                    this.gotoAndStopNative("yellow_s");
                }
                else
                {
                    if (((_arg_1.relation == AllianceConstants.ENEMY_ALLIANCE) || (_arg_1.declaredWarStatus == DeclaredWarConstants.STATUS_WAR)))
                    {
                        this.gotoAndStopNative("red_s");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (_arg_1.relation == AllianceConstants.FRIEND_ALLIANCE)
                        {
                            this.gotoAndStopNative("blue_s");
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (_arg_1.relation == AllianceConstants.SAME_ALLIANCE)
                            {
                                this.gotoAndStopNative("green_s");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                if (_arg_1.declaredWarStatus == DeclaredWarConstants.STATUS_PREPARATIONS)
                                {
                                    this.gotoAndStopNative("purple_s");
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    this.gotoAndStopNative("white_s");
                                };
                            };
                        };
                    };
                };
            }
            else
            {
                this.gotoAndStopNative("orange_s");
            };
        }


    }

        private function checkGuideText():void
        {

                    {

                    };

                    {
                        GuideStep.getInstance().step150();
                    };

            };

                            else

                                else

        public function onMapKeyDown(event:KeyboardEvent):void
        {
            var isMapMove:Boolean;
            if (event.keyCode == Keyboard.UP)
            {
                isMapMove = true;
                this.worldMap.setPoint(worldMap.center_x, (worldMap.center_y - 2));
            }
            else
            {
                if (event.keyCode == Keyboard.DOWN)
                {
                    isMapMove = true;
                    this.worldMap.setPoint(worldMap.center_x, (worldMap.center_y + 2));
                }
                else
                {
                    if (event.keyCode == Keyboard.LEFT)
                    {
                        isMapMove = true;
                        this.worldMap.setPoint((worldMap.center_x - 2), worldMap.center_y);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (event.keyCode == Keyboard.RIGHT)
                        {
                            isMapMove = true;
                            this.worldMap.setPoint((worldMap.center_x + 2), worldMap.center_y);
                        };
                    };
                };
            };
            if (isMapMove)
            {
                gx.text = String(worldMap.center_x);
                gy.text = String(worldMap.center_y);
                try
                {
                    if (MapPos.instance != null)
                    {
                        MapPos.instance.gx.text = String(worldMap.center_x);
                        MapPos.instance.gy.text = String(worldMap.center_y);
                    };
                }
                catch(e:Error)
                {
                };
            };
        }

        private function manageBtnClick(_arg_1:MouseEvent):void
        {
            switch (_arg_1.target)
            {
                case inviteBtn:
                    MsgDispacther.getInstance().dispatchEvent(new WindowChangeEvent(AllianceWin.CALL_OTHER_VIEW, {"id":"inviteMember"}));
                    break;
                case checkApplyBtn:
                    MsgDispacther.getInstance().dispatchEvent(new WindowChangeEvent(AllianceWin.CALL_OTHER_VIEW, {"id":"checkApply"}));
                    break;
                case memberLimitBtn:
                    MsgDispacther.getInstance().dispatchEvent(new WindowChangeEvent(AllianceWin.CALL_OTHER_VIEW, {"id":"allianceMemberList"}));
                    break;
                case introduceBtn:
                    MsgDispacther.getInstance().dispatchEvent(new WindowChangeEvent(AllianceWin.CALL_OTHER_VIEW, {"id":"allianceIntro"}));
                    break;
                case diplomacyBtn:
                    MsgDispacther.getInstance().dispatchEvent(new WindowChangeEvent(AllianceWin.CALL_OTHER_VIEW, {"id":"allianceDiplomacy"}));
                    break;
                case sendMailBtn:
                    MsgDispacther.getInstance().dispatchEvent(new WindowChangeEvent(AllianceWin.CALL_OTHER_VIEW, {"id":"allianceMail"}));
                    break;
                case changeLeaderBtn:
                    ChangeCovenanter.show();
                    break;
                case officalResignBtn:
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getAllianceManagementCommands().resignForAlliance();
                    break;
                case exitAllianceBtn:
                    if (officalLevel != AllianceConstants.TOP_POWER_FOR_ALLIANCE)
                    {
                        AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("退出联盟的提示"), onClickOk, Lang.msg("确定"), Lang.msg("取消"));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ActionFactory.getInstance().getAllianceManagementCommands().sayByetoAlliance();
                    };
                    break;
            };
            if (((!(_arg_1.target == officalResignBtn)) || (!(_arg_1.target == exitAllianceBtn))))
            {
                PopUpManager.removePopUp(this);
            };
        }

        public function __resetLevel_click(_arg_1:MouseEvent):void
        {

        private function changePower():void
        {
            if (officePostCB.selectedItem["data"] == memberInfoBean.levelId)
            {
                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("该成员已经是{0}", officePostCB.selectedLabel));
            }
            else
            {
                ActionFactory.getInstance().getAllianceManagementCommands().setPowerForUserByAlliance(memberInfoBean.userName, officePostCB.selectedItem["data"]);
            };
        }

        private function writeMail():void
        {
            MsgDispacther.getInstance().dispatchEvent(new WindowChangeEvent(AllianceWin.CALL_OTHER_VIEW, {

            }));
            PopUpManager.removePopUp(this);
        }

        private function saveEmail():void

        private function registerHandle():void
        {
            emailError.text = "";
            passwordError.text = "";
            if (regiserName.text == "")
            {
                emailError.text = Lang.msg("输入不能为空");
                return;
            };
            if (regiserpass.text == "")
            {
                passwordError.text = Lang.msg("输入不能为空");
                return;
            };
            if (!validateEmail(this.regiserName.text))
            {
                emailError.text = Lang.msg("邮箱格式不正确");
                return;
            };
            if (this.regiserpass.text.length < 6)
            {
                passwordError.text = Lang.msg("密码不能少于六位");
                return;
            };
            if (InputTextFilter.isChinese(this.regiserpass.text))
            {
                passwordError.text = Lang.msg("密码不合法");
                return;
            };
            username = StringUtil.trim(this.regiserName.text);
            password = StringUtil.trim(this.regiserpass.text);
            saveEmail();
        }

package view.module.guide
{
    import mx.core.UIComponent;
    import flash.media.SoundChannel;
    import flash.media.Sound;
    import flash.events.Event;
    import view.MainWin;
    import flash.net.URLRequest;

    public class TextAndSound extends UIComponent 
    {

        public static const EVENT_COMPLETE:String = "eventComplete";

        private var _channel:SoundChannel;
        private var _sound:Sound;
        private var _textLoaded:Boolean;
        private var _soundLoaded:Boolean;


        private function soundLoaded(_arg_1:Event):void
        {
            _textLoaded = true;
            _soundLoaded = true;
            checkFinish();
        }

        public function stop():void
        {
            if (_channel)
            {
                _channel.stop();
            };
        }

        private function textLoaded(_arg_1:Event):void
        {
        }

        public function play():void
        {
            if ((((MainWin.instance) && (MainWin.instance.guideLady)) && (MainWin.instance.guideLady._needSound)))
            {
                _channel = new SoundChannel();
                _channel = _sound.play();
                _channel.addEventListener(Event.SOUND_COMPLETE, onComplete);
            };
        }

        private function onComplete(_arg_1:Event):void
        {
            MainWin.instance.guideLady.b_paly = true;
        }

        public function playOn():void
        {
            if (_channel)
            {
                _channel = _sound.play();
            };
        }

        public function source(_arg_1:String, _arg_2:String=null):void
        {
            if (MainWin.instance.guideLady._needSound)
            {
                _sound = new Sound();
                _sound.addEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, soundLoaded);
                _sound.load(new URLRequest(_arg_2));
            }
            else
            {
                _textLoaded = true;
                checkFinish();
            };
        }

        private function checkFinish():void
        {
            if (MainWin.instance.guideLady._needSound)
            {
                if (((_textLoaded) && (_soundLoaded)))
                {
                    dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENT_COMPLETE));
                };
            }
            else
            {
                dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENT_COMPLETE));
            };
        }


    }
}//package view.module.guide

        public function onAlertClose(_arg_1:Boolean):void
        {
            switch (_arg_1)
            {
                case true:
                    if (curCallAlert == "washHero")
                    {
                        if (canUseGood())
                        {
                            if (ExternalInterface.available)
                            {
                                ExternalInterface.call("callByIngameUse", "hero.reset.1", "Holy Water", "宝物", "20");
                            };
                            ActionFactory.getInstance().getHeroCommand().resetPoint(Context.getInstance().getCurCastle().id, heroMes.id);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("物品不足确定购买"), doWashHero, Lang.msg("确定"), Lang.msg("取消"));
                        };
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (curCallAlert == "fireHero")
                        {
                            ActionFactory.getInstance().getHeroCommand().fireHero(Context.getInstance().getCurCastle().id, heroMes.id);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (curCallAlert == "releaseHero")
                            {
                                ActionFactory.getInstance().getHeroCommand().releaseHero(Context.getInstance().getCurCastle().id, heroMes.id);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                if (curCallAlert == "persuadeSurrender")
                                {
                                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getHeroCommand().tryGetSeizedHero(Context.getInstance().getCurCastle().id, heroMes.id);
                                };
                            };
                        };
                    };
                    return;
                case false:
                    return;
            };
        }

        private function sendMail():void
        {
            if (this.sendTitle.text == "")
            {
                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("主题不能为空"));
                return;
            };
            if (this.receiveName.text == "")
            {
                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("收信人不能为空"));
                return;
            };
            if (this.sendContent.text == "")
            {
                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("邮件内容不能为空"));
                return;
            };
            if ((getNowDateToNumber() - iPreTime) < 5)
            {
                AlertWin.show("There is a 5 second cooldown on sending messages.");
                return;
            };
            ActionFactory.getInstance().getMailCommands().sendMail(receiveName.text, this.sendTitle.text, this.sendContent.text, onSendMail);
            iPreTime = getNowDateToNumber();
        }

                    };
                };
            };
        }

        private function submitHandle(_arg_1:MouseEvent):void
        {
            if (newName.text != "")
            {
                if (newName.text.length <= 10)
                {
                    instance = ResponseDispatcher.getInstance();
                    if (BadWordCollection.instance.isBadWord(newName.text))
                    {
                        AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("名字不合法"));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        instance.addEventListener(ResponseDispatcher.CITY_MODIFY_CASTLE_NAME, modifyResponse, false, 0, true);
                        ActionFactory.getInstance().getCityCommands().modifyCastleName(this.curCastle.id, String(newName.text), this.faceSource);
                        if (this.parent != null)
                        {
                            PopUpManager.removePopUp(this);
                        };
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("城市名不能超过10个字符"));
                };
            }
            else
            {
                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("城市名不能为空"));
            };
        }

                Context.getInstance().getPlayerBean().changedFace = true;
                MinePopupManager.instance.removePopup();
            };
        }

        [Bindable(event="propertyChange")]
        private function get SexFlag():Boolean
        {
            return (this._642046766SexFlag);
        }

        private function onSubmit():void
        {
            ActionFactory.getInstance().getCommonCommands().changeUserFace(this.faceSource, this.sex, onChangeResponse);
        }

        public function ___PlayerFaceSelect_Image1_complete(_arg_1:Event):void
        {
            onLoadComplete(_arg_1);
        }

        [Bindable(event="propertyChange")]
        private function get faceSource():String
        {
            return (this._571486424faceSource);
        }

        public function ___PlayerFaceSelect_Canvas1_creationComplete(_arg_1:FlexEvent):void
        {
            init();
        }

        private function resetFaceArray():void
        {
            this.faceIndex = 0;
            if (this.sex == 0)
            {
                this.faceArray = LogoEumDefine.getMalePlayerLogoArray();
            }
            else
            {
                this.faceArray = LogoEumDefine.getFemalePlayerLogoArray();
            };
            this.faceSource = this.faceArray[this.faceIndex];
        }


    }
}//package view.module.playerInfo

        private function changeZone():void
        {

            {
                if ((((!(inputH1.text == "")) && (!(inputM1.text == ""))) || (buffFlag)))
                {
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getTruceCommands().setDreamTruce(int(inputH1.text), int(inputM1.text), int(inputS1.text), SHA1.hash(statePassword.text), setTruceResponse);
                    hide();
                }
                else
                {
                    AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("请输入时间"), null);
                };
            }
            else
            {
                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("请输入密码"));
            };
        }

        private function setTruceResponse(_arg_1:CommandResponse):void
        {
            if (_arg_1.ok == CommandResponse.OK_DEFAULT)
            {
                MyTreasure.instance.refresh();
                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("休战时间设置成功"), null);
            }
            else
            {
                AlertWin.show(_arg_1.errorMsg);
            };
        }

        private function btnHandle():void
        {
            if (statePassword.text != "")
            {
                if (stateChoise.selectedItem.data != 0)
                {
                    if (((!(inputH1.text == "")) && (!(inputM1.text == ""))))
                    {
                        ActionFactory.getInstance().getTruceCommands().changeDreamTruceTime(int(inputH1.text), int(inputM1.text), int(inputS1.text), SHA1.hash(statePassword.text), changeTruceResponse);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("请输入时间"));
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    if (stateChoise.selectedItem.data == 0)
                    {
                        ActionFactory.getInstance().getTruceCommands().cancelDreamTruce(SHA1.hash(statePassword.text), setNormalResponse);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("请选择您要更改的状态"), null);
                    };
                };
            }
            else
            {
                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("请输入密码"), null);

                    };
                };

        }

        private function btnClickHandle(_arg_1:MouseEvent):void
        {
            PopUpManager.removePopUp(this);
            if (this.itemEum.id == "player.item.stoneoffinding")
            {
                AllWindows.switchToFuncWindow(DisappearHeroList.EVENT_SHOW);
                return;
            };
            if (this.itemEum.id == "player.peace.1")

                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("外交书是在玩家信息中更改状态时使用"), null);
                return;
            };
            if (this.itemEum.id == "player.truce.dream")
            {
                StopWar.show(this.itemEum.id);
                PopUpManager.removePopUp(this);
                return;
            };
            if (this.itemEum.id == "player.box.present.4")
            {
                if (checkOffice())
                {
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getShopCommands().useGoods(Context.getInstance().getCurCastle().id, this.itemEum.id, 1);
                }
                else
                {
                    AlertWin.show(this.itemEum.itemDesc, null);
                };
                return;
            };
            if ((((this.itemEum.id == "player.box.3") || (this.itemEum.id == "player.box.2")) || (this.itemEum.id == "player.box.1")))
            {
                if (this.itemEum.id == "player.box.3")
                {
                    checkOut("consume.key.3", "player.box.3");
                };
                if (this.itemEum.id == "player.box.2")
                {
                    checkOut("consume.key.2", "player.box.2");
                };
                if (this.itemEum.id == "player.box.1")
                {
                    checkOut("consume.key.1", "player.box.1");
                };
            }
            else
            {
                if (this.itemEum.id == "consume.move.1")
                {
                    if (canUseGood("consume.move.1"))
                    {
                        MoveCityWin.show(_arg_1);
                        PopUpManager.removePopUp(this);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("您没有迁城令"), null);
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    if (this.itemEum.id == "player.more.castle.1.a")
                    {
                        if (canUseGood("player.more.castle.1.a"))
                        {
                            DesignatedMoveCityWin.show(_arg_1, 0);
                            PopUpManager.removePopUp(this);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("您没有高级迁城令"), null);
                        };
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (this.itemEum.id == "player.more.castle.1.c")
                        {
                            if (canUseGood("player.more.castle.1.c"))
                            {
                                DesignatedMoveCityWin2.show(_arg_1);
                                PopUpManager.removePopUp(this);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("您没有高级迁城令"), null);
                            };
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (this.itemEum.id == "consume.key.3")
                            {
                                checkOut("player.box.3");
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                if (this.itemEum.id == "consume.key.2")
                                {
                                    checkOut("player.box.2");
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (this.itemEum.id == "consume.key.1")
                                    {
                                        checkOut("player.box.1");
                                    }
                                    else

                                        if (((((((this.itemEum.id == "player.heart.1.a") || (this.itemEum.id == "player.pop.1.a")) || (this.itemEum.id == "player.haunted.castle")) || (this.itemEum.id == "player.haunted.castle.adv")) || (this.itemEum.id == "player.halloween.castle")) || (this.itemEum.id == "player.halloween.castle.adv")))

                                            return;

                                        if (this.itemEum.id == "player.box.hero.npc")

                                        }

                                            }

            result[0] = binding;
            return (result);
        }

        private function init():void
        {
            if (!Context.getInstance().userIsFirstLogin)
            {
                this.visible = false;
            };
        }


    }

                {
                    this.showDigiBtn2 = true;
                };
            };
            this.myViewstack.selectedChild = this.questInfoVs;
            this.curQuest = (_arg_1.itemRenderer.data as QuestBean);
            if (this.showHeroList)
            {
                if (this.curQuestType.typeId != 1000000)
                {
                    if ((((this.curQuest.questId == 488) || (this.curQuest.questId == 498)) || (this.curQuest.questId == 504)))
                    {
                        this.showDelTaskBtn = false;
                        this.showDecBtn = false;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (this.curQuest.isFinish)
                        {
                            this.showDecBtn = false;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            this.showDecBtn = true;
                        };
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    this.showDecBtn = false;
                    this.showDelTaskBtn = true;
                };
            };
            this.curSelectSubQuestIndex = DataGrid(_arg_1.currentTarget).selectedIndex;
            if (this.curQuest.name == Lang.msg("新手收藏夹任务"))
            {
                _local_2 = 0;
                while (_local_2 < this.curQuest.targetsArray.length)
                {
                    _local_3 = (this.curQuest.targetsArray[_local_2] as QuestTargetBean);
                    _local_3.name = _local_3.name.toString().replace("%s", GameConfig.instance.homePage);
                    _local_2++;
                };
            };
            showFavotiteBtn = ((!(this.curQuest.isFinish)) && (this.curQuest.name == Lang.msg("新手收藏夹任务")));
        }

        private function onRankBtnClick(_arg_1:MouseEvent):void
        {
            var _local_2:int;
            this.isExactMatch = true;
            if (_arg_1.target == this.orderSearch)
            {
                if (this.textInPutOrder.text == "")
                {
                    AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("查询名次至少从1开始！"));
                }
                else
                {
                    _local_2 = int(this.textInPutOrder.text);
                    if (_local_2 > (this.totalPage * 10))
                    {
                        _local_2 = (this.totalPage * 10);
                    };
                    this.isExactMatchTpye = "num";
                    this.searchStr = "";
                    readFromServer(null, _local_2, typeId);
                };
            }
            else
            {
                if (_arg_1.target == this.nameSearch)
                {
                    if (this.textInputKey.text == "")
                    {
                        AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("查询名称不能为空！"));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (this.textInputKey.text.length > 30)
                        {
                            AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("该玩家名称无效!"));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            this.isExactMatchTpye = "name";
                            readFromServer(this.textInputKey.text, -1, typeId);
                        };
                    };
                };
            };
        }

        private function searchOwer():void
        {
            this.isExactMatch = true;
            this.isExactMatchTpye = "mySearch";

            }

                {

                    {
                        this.mySearchStr = _local_1.alliance;
                        ActionFactory.getInstance().getRankCommands().getAllianceRank(_local_1.alliance, this.pageNo, pageSize, this.typeId);
                    }

                    };
                };
            };
        }

        private function submitHandel():void
        {
            if (num.text != "")
            {
                if (UIUtil.checkItem(this._ItemEum.id, 1))
                {
                    ResponseDispatcher.getInstance().addEventListener(ResponseDispatcher.SHOP_BUY, shopBuyResponse, false, 0, true);
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getShopCommands().buy(this._ItemEum.id, int(this.num.text));
                }
                else
                {
                    AddFundWin.show();
                };
            }
            else
            {
                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("请填入购买数量"), null);
            };
        }

        private function shopBuyResponse(_arg_1:CommandResponse):void
        {
            if (_arg_1.ok != CommandResponse.OK_DEFAULT)
            {
                AlertWin.show(_arg_1.errorMsg);
            }
            else
            {
                if (ExternalInterface.available)
                {
                    ExternalInterface.call("callByIngameBuy", "1", int((int(num.text) * _ItemEum.price)), this._ItemEum.id, this._ItemEum.name, this._ItemEum.itemType, this._ItemEum.price, int(num.text));
                };
            };
            onClose();
        }

        private function onMouseOver(_arg_1:MouseEvent):void
        {
            setToolTip();
            tips.moveToMouse(_arg_1);
            if (tips.parent == null)
            {
                PopUpManager.addPopUp(tips, this);
            }
            else
            {
                PopUpManager.bringToFront(tips);
            };
        }

        private function onTimer(_arg_1:TimerEvent):void
        {

            {
                return;
            };
            itemId = getItemId();
            if (itemId == "")

                AlertWin.show("Automatically upgrade the star's level stop,you have reach the level!");
                autoStatusChange(false);
                return;
            };
            if (checkAutoItem(itemId) != 0)
            {

                {
                    showBuyItem(itemId, 4);
                    return;
                };
                if (Context.getInstance().getPlayerBean().playerInfo.medal > (ItemEumDefine.getItemEum(itemId).price * 4))
                {

                }

                {

                    autoStatusChange(false);
                };
                return;
            };
            if (!stopFlag)

                ActionFactory.getInstance().getEquipmentCommands().EnhancedStarByGemStone(itemId, 4, equipTechBean.typeId, onAutoStarResponse);
            };

        private function onMapKeyDown(event:KeyboardEvent):void
        {
            var isMapMove:Boolean;
            if (event.keyCode == Keyboard.UP)
            {
                isMapMove = true;
                try
                {
                    if (Map.instance != null)
                    {
                        Map.instance.worldMap.setPoint(Map.instance.worldMap.center_x, (Map.instance.worldMap.center_y - 2));
                    };
                }
                catch(e:Error)
                {
                };
            }
            else
            {
                if (event.keyCode == Keyboard.DOWN)
                {
                    isMapMove = true;
                    try
                    {
                        if (Map.instance != null)
                        {
                            Map.instance.worldMap.setPoint(Map.instance.worldMap.center_x, (Map.instance.worldMap.center_y + 2));
                        };
                    }
                    catch(e:Error)
                    {
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    if (event.keyCode == Keyboard.LEFT)
                    {
                        isMapMove = true;
                        try
                        {
                            if (Map.instance != null)
                            {
                                Map.instance.worldMap.setPoint((Map.instance.worldMap.center_x - 2), Map.instance.worldMap.center_y);
                            };
                        }
                        catch(e:Error)
                        {
                        };
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (event.keyCode == Keyboard.RIGHT)
                        {
                            isMapMove = true;
                            try
                            {
                                if (Map.instance != null)
                                {
                                    Map.instance.worldMap.setPoint((Map.instance.worldMap.center_x + 2), Map.instance.worldMap.center_y);
                                };
                            }
                            catch(e:Error)
                            {
                            };
                        };
                    };
                };
            };
            if (isMapMove)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (Map.instance != null)
                    {
                        gx.text = String(Map.instance.worldMap.center_x);
                        gy.text = String(Map.instance.worldMap.center_y);
                    };
                }
                catch(e:Error)
                {
                };
            };
        }

                };

            else
            {
                ActionFactory.getInstance().getCommonCommands().setReceiveIncomingAttack(false);
            };
        }

        private function onWindowChange(_arg_1:WindowChangeEvent):void
        {
            var _local_2:BaseNewBuildingWin;
            MinePopupManager.instance.removePopup();
            PopUpManager.removePopUp(UIFactory.getInstance().getBuildingTooltip());
            AlertWin.close();
            if (_arg_1.getId() == WindowChangeEvent.ID_CLOSE)
            {
                EnterKeyDispatcher.instance.onEnterKeyEvent();
                if (this.currentWin != null)
                {
                    this.currentWin.destroy();
                };
                this.visible = false;
                if (((!(TownView.instance == null)) && (TownView.instance.isShow)))
                {
                    TownView.singleton().restorePlayAll();
                };
                if (MainFrame.instance != null)
                {
                    if (((!(MainFrame.instance.cityView == null)) && (MainFrame.instance.cityView.isShow)))
                    {
                        CityView.singleton().restorePlayAll();
                    };
                    if (((!(MainFrame.instance.mapWin == null)) && (MainFrame.instance.mapWin.isShow)))
                    {
                        MainFrame.instance.mapWin.restorePlayAll();
                    };
                };
                if (((!(MainWin == null)) && (!(MainWin.instance == null))))
                {
                    MainWin.instance.guidLadyBottom = 140;
                };
            }
            else
            {
                if (this.currentWin != null)
                {
                    this.currentWin.destroy();
                };
                if (TownView.instance != null)
                {
                    TownView.instance.stopPlayAll();
                };
                if (MainFrame.instance.cityView != null)
                {
                    CityView.singleton().stopPlayAll();
                };
                if (MainFrame.instance.mapWin != null)
                {
                    MainFrame.instance.mapWin.stopPlayAll();
                };
                trace(("AllWindows.onWindowChange(): event=" + _arg_1.getId()));
                if (((_arg_1.getId() == MailWin.EVENT_SHOW) || (_arg_1.getId() == AllianceWin.EVENT_SHOW)))
                {
                    EnterKeyDispatcher.instance.offEnterKeyEvent();
                };
                this.currentWin = (this.winMap[_arg_1.getId()] as BaseWindow);
                if (currentWin != null)
                {
                    this.visible = true;
                    this.viewstack1.selectedChild = currentWin;
                    if ((currentWin is BaseNewBuildingWin))
                    {
                        _local_2 = (currentWin as BaseNewBuildingWin);
                        if (_arg_1.getId() != NewWallBuilding.EVENT_SHOW)
                        {
                            _local_2.setSpace((_arg_1 as OpenNewBuildingWindowEvent).getSpace());
                        };
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        this.currentWin.eventData = (_arg_1 as WindowChangeEvent).getEventData();
                    };
                    this.currentWin.onShowEvent();
                    if (((((_arg_1.getId() == QuestWin.EVENT_SHOW) && (Context.getInstance().needUserGuide)) && (!(MainWin.instance == null))) && (MainWin.instance.height < 800)))
                    {
                        MainWin.instance.guidLadyBottom = 0;
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    trace(("AllWindows.onWindowChange(): Window not found! event=" + _arg_1.getId()));
                };
            };
        }

                lastCalcFPSTime = getTimer();
                currentFPS = 15;
            }
            else
            {
                _local_1 = ((getTimer() - lastCalcFPSTime) / 1000);
                if (_local_1 > 20)

                    currentFPS = (nFramecount / _local_1);

        private function changeSkin():void
        {
            try
            {
                if (curSkin == "Classic")
                {
                    StyleManager.unloadStyleDeclarations("fla/skins/evonySkinClassic.swf");
                    StyleManager.loadStyleDeclarations("fla/skins/evonySkin.swf");
                    curSkin = "Normal";
                }
                else
                {
                    StyleManager.unloadStyleDeclarations("fla/skins/evonySkin.swf");
                    StyleManager.loadStyleDeclarations("fla/skins/evonySkinClassic.swf");
                    curSkin = "Classic";
                };
            }
            catch(e)
            {

        private function skipTutorial():void
        {
            if (ExternalInterface.available)
            {
                ExternalInterface.call("tour_by_flash", Context.getInstance().iPicId, "skip", GuideStep.getInstance().currentStep, "", GameConfig.instance.serverID);
            };
            GuideStep.getInstance().setCurrentStep(999);
            this.SkipTutorialBtn.visible = false;
            MainWin.instance.guideLady.includeInLayout = false;
            MainWin.instance.guideLady.visible = false;

//_view_module_info_infoWin_ArmyDetailsWinWatcherSetupUtil

package 
{
    import flash.display.Sprite;
    import mx.binding.IWatcherSetupUtil;
    import view.module.info.infoWin.ArmyDetailsWin;
    import mx.core.IFlexModuleFactory;
    import mx.binding.PropertyWatcher;
    import mx.binding.FunctionReturnWatcher;

    public class _view_module_info_infoWin_ArmyDetailsWinWatcherSetupUtil extends Sprite implements IWatcherSetupUtil 
    {


        public static function init(_arg_1:IFlexModuleFactory):void
        {
            ArmyDetailsWin.watcherSetupUtil = new (_view_module_info_infoWin_ArmyDetailsWinWatcherSetupUtil)();
        }


        public function setup(target:Object, propertyGetter:Function, bindings:Array, watchers:Array):void
        {
            watchers[12] = new PropertyWatcher("armyOb", {"propertyChange":true}, [bindings[15], bindings[13], bindings[14], bindings[12]], propertyGetter);
            watchers[17] = new FunctionReturnWatcher("hasOwnProperty", target, function ():Array
            {
                return (["heroName"]);
            }, {"propertyChange":true}, [bindings[14]], null);
            watchers[15] = new FunctionReturnWatcher("hasOwnProperty", target, function ():Array
            {
                return (["Alliance"]);
            }, {"propertyChange":true}, [bindings[13]], null);
            watchers[14] = new PropertyWatcher("Lord", {"propertyChange":true}, [bindings[12]], null);
            watchers[13] = new FunctionReturnWatcher("hasOwnProperty", target, function ():Array
            {

//------------------------------------------------------------
//_VRuleStyle

package 
{
    import mx.styles.CSSStyleDeclaration;
    import mx.styles.StyleManager;
    import mx.core.IFlexModuleFactory;

    public class _VRuleStyle 
    {


        public static function init(fbs:IFlexModuleFactory):void
        {
            var style:CSSStyleDeclaration = StyleManager.getStyleDeclaration("VRule");
            if (!style)
            {
                style = new CSSStyleDeclaration();
                StyleManager.setStyleDeclaration("VRule", style, false);
            };
            if (style.defaultFactory == null)
            {
                style.defaultFactory = function ():void
                {
                    this.strokeWidth = 2;
                    this.strokeColor = 12897484;
                };
            };
        }


    }
}//package

                            AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("服务器正在关闭"), afterConnectLost, "Ok", null);

                            if (_arg_1.reasonCode == ConnectionLost.SERVER_START)
                            {
                                AlertWin.show(Lang.msg("服务器正在启动"), afterConnectLost, "Ok", null);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                AlertWin.show(_arg_1.msg, afterConnectLost, "Ok", null);

                        };
                    };
                };
            };

            stopLoginMovie();
        }
